# ViraStack Start v1 (archived)

> Archived guide for `virastack` 1.2. v1 is no longer maintained. For new projects use 2.0: [llms.txt](https://virastack.com/start/llms.txt). What changed in 2.0: [release note](https://virastack.com/releases/start/2.0.0).

Install v1 explicitly: `npx virastack@1`. Feature-based Next.js and TanStack Start templates with ViraStack AI rules, three design skills and optional ViraStack tools (Mask, Password, Address).

For inline CLI + template detail, prefer [llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/start/v1/llms-full.txt).

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://virastack.com/start/docs/v1): What Start is and why to use it
- [Installation](https://virastack.com/start/docs/v1/installation): Questions, setup order, design skills, post-install steps
- [CLI](https://virastack.com/start/docs/v1/cli): Commands, flags (`--agent`, `--tools`), `virastack add`, non-interactive usage
- [Templates](https://virastack.com/start/docs/v1/templates): Next.js / TanStack Start, with or without i18n, file tree and tests
- [Scripts](https://virastack.com/start/docs/v1/scripts): Day-to-day, quality, test and CI scripts
- [i18n](https://virastack.com/start/docs/v1/i18n): Locales and message files in multi-language templates
- [llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/start/v1/llms-full.txt): Full machine-readable Start v1 guide

## Product

- [Start overview](https://virastack.com/start): Marketing page
